In the background, pale purple mountains are faintly visible on the horizon, with a sky of pastel blue and lavender hues above scattered with wispy white clouds. Closer to us, trees and hills in shades of gold, green, and brown lead down towards the water.

items.title: Tigers and  Leopard Frolicking
items.description: This monochrome composition depicts a tiger and her young playing at stalking one another in a stand of pine. Tigers, considered messengers of mountain spirits, and are often paired with leopards, mistakenly thought to be baby tigers. The signature written at the upper left of the painting reads "The mountain recluse of Honam," possibly referring to a painter from Jeolla province in Korea.

items.title: Boston Harbor
items.description: This painting shows a seascape with sailboats and ships on the water. On the left is a small boat with its sails tied and several people aboard. A larger ship with unfurled sails and an American flag is in the center. On the right is the tallest sailing ship, with billowing white sails and a red-and-white flag atop its masts. There are more boats visible in the distance to the left and right, and they all have people faintly visible on their decks. The horizon is low against the sky, revealing a distant shoreline with buildings and trees on the left.

items.title: Peonies
items.artist: Korea, Joseon dynasty (1392−1910) or Japanese colonial period (1910−1945)
items.medium: Eight-panel folding screen; ink and color on silk
items.description: By the late nineteenth century, peony paintings with bold designs and striking graphic stylization were increasingly produced and consumed by middle-class members because of its symbolic meaning: prosperity and wealth. This early 20th-century folding screen of peonies may have used for festive occasions such as weddings.

items.title: A Pier Overlooking Dordrecht
items.description: We look across a body of calm water onto a wooden pier, rowboats, sailboats, and a town on the distant shore, all beneath a cloudy sky that takes up the top three-quarters of this horizontal landscape. The pier extends into the scene from the left edge, and stretches about a quarter of the way across the painting’s width. Three men and a woman, all with light skin, stand in a group near a fourth man, who sits on a piling at the front corner. They all wear charcoal-gray, muted blue, or fawn-brown clothing and hats.

items.title: Peonies and Rocks
items.artist: Korea, Joseon dynasty (1392−1910) or Japanese colonial period (1910−1945)
items.medium: Six-panel folding screen; ink and color on silk
items.description: By the late nineteenth century, peony paintings with bold designs and striking graphic stylization were increasingly produced and consumed by middle-class members because of its symbolic meaning: prosperity and wealth.

items.title: Marina delle Torri
items.description: This painting depicts a harbor scene from an elevated viewpoint, overlooking moored boats with people sitting in them. On the right is a tall, pale-yellow building with arched doorways and a large towner, partially covered with green vegetation, next to a pile of large gray rocks. At the bottom of the painting, several people stand on a rocky platform, some carrying wooden boxes or barrels. The people wear clothes in shades of red, yellow, and brown, and more people can be seen in small boats on the water nearby.

items.title: Bamboos in Wind
items.medium: Ten-panel folding screen; ink on paper
items.description: Active during the Japanese colonial period in Korea (1910–45), the artist Jin-woo Kim earned his artistic reputation for his expressive renditions of bamboo swaying in a strong wind. His piercing bamboo shoots are often compared to an iron spear, and their sharp leaves to a knife. It is believed that he deliberately emphasized sharpness in his brushstrokes to express his strong resistance against Japanese colonial oppression.

items.title: An Evening Halt - Emigrants Moving to the West in 1840
Grand Canal with the Rialto Bridge, Venice
items.description: We look down and across a canal filled with more than two dozen gondolas and sailing boats, and flanked by rows golden-yellow and parchment-white buildings connected by a wide, arched bridge in this horizontal landscape painting. Some of the boats are pulled up to the buildings lining the water, and others weave through the canal, guided by one or two people each. Closest to us, two long, low, slender gondolas are angled toward each other. Other boats have curving, cabin-like structures, and there are three sailing ships with tall masts among the gondolas.

items.title: Yahagi Bridge at Okazaki (Station 39),  From the series Fifty-Three Stations of the Tokaido
The Great Windmill and the Rainbow
Amsterdam Harbor Scene
items.description: A sage-green harbor teems with more than a dozen sailing ships and rowboats under a pale gray sky in this horizontal painting. The horizon comes about one-fifth of the way up the composition, and dark gray and white clouds tower above. Light filters onto the scene through the clouds from our left to fall across the ships while casting shadows on the water nearest us. Painted in tones of slate gray and warm brown, most of the ships closest to us have their sails furled so the masts and horizontal yard arms bristle against the sky. The larger ships have cannons poking out of square portholes.

items.title: Kanō, from the series Sixty-nine Stations of the Kisokaidō
items.medium: Color woodblock print, ink and color on paper

items.title: Country House in a Park
items.description: A garden with two fountains stretches back to a manor house in the distance in this horizontal landscape painting. The horizon comes about a third of the way up the composition, and gray clouds tower in the vivid blue sky above. A pine tree closer to us to the left of center rises high against the sky. There are a few more evergreens to the right among dark-green canopied trees. A yellowed pine tree has fallen on the grassy lawn in the lower left quadrant of the composition. Just beyond this, the fountain to the left has a tall, columnar base under a dish-like basin.

items.title: Capriccio of a Harbor
items.description: This painting depicts a harbor scene with brown arches and towers on the right, along with tall columns that look like ruins. At the bottom of the painting, people are engaged in various activities along the water's edge. Some carry boxes, others tie barrels together, and others converse with each other. Some of the people wear long coats and tricorn hats while others wear turbans and draped shawls over robes. The buildings and ruins, including a tower and a bridge, dominate the right side of the painting, with the tall columns on the far right.

items.title: Full Moon over Takanawa, from the series Famous Places in the Eastern Capital
Sioux Village - Lac du Cygne
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a wide expanse of land with a line of trees, rolling hills, tipis, figures in canoes on a river or lake, and people gathered around the tipis. The brushstrokes are smooth and meticulous, capturing details in the landscape and structures. The color palette is warm and tranquil, with shades of light yellow, green, and brown dominating the land, transitioning into the orange and pink tones of the sky. The sky features a few wispy clouds.

items.title: Village by the River
items.description: The painting shows a coastal area. Across the water, the horizon is behind several buildings of different colors, with trees and white fences between them. In the center, there is a small green island, a steamship, and a sailboat, as well as some black and white birds. Tall trees with dark green leaves are on a small section of land near the bottom right corner, with flying birds above them and a small person dressed in dark clothing sitting below them. The sky above is cloudy, and the water below reflects the clouds.

items.title: Shinagawa (from the series Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido)
Mahantango Valley Farm
items.description: We look down at a cluster of three farm buildings and across grassy fields that stretch into the distance in this horizontal landscape painting. A parchment-yellow road angles from the lower center of the composition into the upper right corner, where it meets the horizon line just below the upper edge of the painting. Closest to us, the buildings flank the road, with two barns to our left and a house to our right. The buildings all have burgundy-red roofs. The barns have brown siding, and the house has paler, tan siding. The buildings are surrounded by blue or red fences.

items.title: The Shipwreck
items.description: A masted ship with tattered sails crashes near a rocky shore among choppy waves, beneath a sky filled with charcoal-gray clouds in this horizontal landscape painting. More then two dozen men and women are scattered among the wreckage and along the shore. They all have pale skin and are small in scale within the landscape. Some of them are barefoot, and they wear clothing in ivory white, ruby red, slate gray, beige, or teal blue. The tall mast of the ship pitches at a steep angle from near the lower right corner of the canvas toward the upper left.

items.title: A Mandan Medicine Man
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: This is a painting of Native Americans participating in a ceremonial gathering. The painting depicts a group of people gathered outdoors on a grassy field, encircled by hills under a sky with scattered clouds. At the forefront stands a figure adorned in traditional attire, including a feathered headdress and garments with detailed patterning. The figure appears to be holding ceremonial objects and addressing or leading the assembly. Around this central figure, the people are positioned in various postures, seemingly listening or observing attentively.

items.title: Southern Resort Town
items.description: This painting shows an aerial view of a landscape with green land and pale blue water. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, where there are small green islands with trees on the water in front of a soft blue sky that is almost the same color as the water. A black sailboat is near the center of the painting, moving on the water. On the land on the left is a large gray building with a tower and a fenced-in porch, surrounded by trees and green plants.

items.title: Thirty-Six Views of Mt. Fuji:  The Surface of Lake Misaka in Kai Province
Ignis Fatuus, Rio Uruguay
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image depicts a night scene in a dense and shadowy forest. A faintly illuminated path is visible running horizontally through the scene. Dark silhouettes of trees and foliage surround the path, leading to a strip of warm light shining through the trees. The horizon is obscured by the densely packed trees, creating a continuous dark mass. The artist uses blended brushstrokes to create subtle transitions between light and shadow, adding depth. The color palette consists of deep greens and blacks with touches of muted oranges and yellows where the light breaks through, creating contrast.

items.title: The Seine
items.description: A city skyline is silhouetted in plum purple against a vivid peach and butter-yellow sky in this horizontal landscape painting. The brilliant sky is reflected in the water below, where a boat is moored along a riverbank. The scene is loosely painted with visible brushstrokes throughout. A wedge-shaped piece of olive green could be land or a dock in the lower right corner of the composition. A few people standing near the boat tied to a pier there are loosely painted with strokes of dark green and gray. A shallowly arched bridge marches across the river in the middle distance.

items.title: The Brocade Bridge in Suo Province (from the series Curious Views of Famous Bridges in the Provinces)
Tapuya Encampment
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: This is a painting of a forest scene with dancers and a tent. Figures are dancing in the foreground on green grass, with each figure positioned expressively. More figures are gathered near a tent, and in the background, dense trees fill the scene. A serene body of water is visible through the clearing, surrounded by greenery.

items.title: The Trojans Repairing Their Ships in Sicily
items.description: On the right side of this horizontal painting, two light-skinned men stand close to us on a spit of land separated from the rest of the scene by stretch of water that leads back to a town on the far shore. People gather on and around two boats floating in the water between the spit of land to our right and a copse of trees to our left. Beginning with the pair of men to our right: one man looking toward us has a broad forehead and grizzled blond beard. He wears a brick-red and canary-yellow turban, a yellow and crimson-red striped doublet with puffy sleeves, and a red codpiece.

items.title: The Weir at Senju in Musashi Province (from the series Thirty-Six Views of Mt. Fuji)
The Meeting of David and Abigail
items.description: A man and woman greet each other at the center of a group of about a dozen people set within a landscape in this horizontal painting. All the people have pale, peachy skin. In the middle of the crowd, a woman, Abigail, kneels to our left while a man to our right, David, reaches out to her. Abigail’s blond hair is tied back under a white veil that drapes over her shoulders, and she wears a slate-blue dress and a string of pearls around her neck.

items.title: Ships in Distress off a Rocky Coast
items.description: Beyond several craggy boulders that loom in the lower left corner of this horizontal painting, three sailing ships pitch wildly in crashing waves beneath towering clouds. At the center, a large ship tips sharply to our right with billowing ivory sails and two red, white, and blue striped flags whipping in the wind. White spray kicks up against the side of the boat and in the waves surrounding it. The sails of the second ship, to our right, are furled except for one that crashes down onto the deck. Tiny people scurry around inside the ship, which tilts steeply up on a high wave.

items.title: Poem by Fujiwara no Yoshitaka, from the series One Hundred Poems by One Hundred Poets Explained by an Old Nurse
Study of Clouds over the Roman Campagna
items.description: A sliver of land across the bottom of this composition gives way to a procession of puffy gray and white clouds sweeping up across a vivid blue, panoramic sky in this horizontal landscape painting. An area of darker gray beyond the brown land could be a valley, mountain, or shadows from the billowing clouds. About one-fifth of the way up the composition, the horizon glows the faintest peach. The clouds trundle from our left up and to our right. The view is loosely painted, especially in the land.

items.title: Oyster Sloop, Cos Cob
items.description: This painting shows a man in a yellow jacket standing on a small brown rowboat on a wide, pale green river. Behind him is a large mint-green sailboat, its tall mast bare, the sails folded on the deck. Behind that is a coastline covered in tan paths that cut through green grass. Another person stands on the shore, looking towards the boats. A yellow house with a weathered roof and two smaller, red-toned buildings can be seen on the shoreline. Behind them is more blue water, a grassy field, and dark green trees. The sky above is light gray with hints of blue.

items.title: An Ancient Picture of the Boat Bridge at Sano in Kozuke Province from the series Curious Views of Famous Bridges in the Provinces
Falls of the Snake River
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The painting depicts an elevated point of view of a broad landscape. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant mountains against a light blue sky with scattered clouds. The brushstrokes are smooth and blended, creating depth and atmosphere. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns in the landscape, and cooler blues and grays in the mountains and sky. Close to us, a group of horses stands near trees, with figures by a river and a waterfall in the background. The middle ground contains more trees and greenery leading to the distant horizon.

items.title: A North East Headland
items.description: A rocky shoreline juts into a vivid, aquamarine-blue body of water in this loosely painted, nearly square landscape. The rocky beach and a few pieces of driftwood stretch in front of us in shades of ivory white, sand brown, gold, and mustard yellow to fill the bottom half of the painting. A few touches of shamrock green suggest plants growing in the near distance. A higher, almost flat-topped promontory reaches into the water beyond, nearly spanning the width of the composition. Areas of pine green suggest more growth in the distance near the left edge.

items.title: Spearing by Torchlight
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image depicts a night-time riverscape with a view from the bank of a river. The horizon is in the upper third of the painting, where the river meets a line of trees fading into the night. The brushstrokes give an impressionistic texture to the foliage and water, creating movement and depth. The color palette consists of deep blues and blacks, with a red-orange glow near a light source by the river bank illuminating nearby vegetation. A canoe with figures moves on the water near the light, heading towards the dim shorelines.

items.title: Calm Sea
items.description: A narrow strip of beach and then a vivid turquoise stretch of water give way to a towering, hazy sky in this square landscape painting. The beach is painted with strokes of tan and peachy brown and skimmed with dark brown or black to create the impression of rocks or shells. The water extends to the horizon, which comes a quarter of the way up this composition, in shades of topaz and powder blue. Piles of fluffy clouds above are painted with loose strokes of cotton and gossamer white, creating a soft, blurred look.

items.title: The Moored Boatman: Souvenir of an Italian Lake
items.description: We look across a lush landscape of olive-green forests lining a glimmering, silvery-blue lake with hills in the deep distance under a pale blue sky in this horizontal landscape painting. The scene is painted with some visible and some blended brushstrokes to give it a hazy, soft appearance. A man wearing a red cap and a white shirt sits in a long, low, narrow boat with a pointed bow in the grasses along the shore, near the bottom center of the composition. Gnarled tree trunks, one to each side, frame the view beyond. Towering, leafy trees nearly fill the right half of the painting.

items.title: The Dogana and Santa Maria della Salute, Venice
items.description: Through a golden haze and across an expanse of gently rippling water dotted with boats, ghostly ivory and parchment-white buildings rise along a distant shore in this loosely painted horizontal landscape. The misty horizon comes about a third of the way up the composition, and the sky above is mostly butter yellow with a few touches of shell pink, and a patch of topaz blue in the upper left corner. Closest to us, in the lower right corner, several honey-yellow boats are pulled up to a parchment-white dock.

items.title: An Ancient Picture of the Eight Part Bridge in Mikawa Province (from the series Curious Views of Famous Bridges in the Provinces)
Scenes from a Legend
items.artist: Giovanni Larciani (Master of the Kress Landscapes)
items.description: This painting depicts a long, horizontal landscape viewed from an elevated angle. On the left, by a group of green trees and bushes, several people stand around one person who is on the back of a white horse. They wear garments in shades of light red, dark green, and pale yellow. In the distance behind them, a gray castle is visible, and farther away boats sail across green water near tree-covered hills. In the center of the painting is a collection of massive gray rocks. A small yellow tent is at the bottom of the rocks, with a group of small people sitting or standing around it.

items.title: A Concert
items.description: Shown from the waist up behind a forest-green ledge or tabletop, a bearded man with a ruddy complexion strums a six-stringed lute between two, light-skinned people in this horizontal painting. The green ledge runs close to the bottom edge of the canvas, and the people nearly fill the composition. The musician’s body faces us but he looks up and off to our left with gray eyes under arched brows, with lips parted. His long brown hair is covered with a red hat wrapped with a pale, pink band. The ribbon meets in a bow-like form near the front center, and tassels hang to each side.

items.title: Woman Passing a Roadside Shop Near Oji
Scene from the Lower Mississippi
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image presents a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, looking over a wide river winding into the distance. The horizon is positioned quite low, and the sky dominates the upper half of the scene, displaying a blend of blue with hints of pink and gray clouds. Distant trees frame the river on the horizon. Close to us, the left side features dense clusters of tall trees with green foliage, while the opposite riverbank to the right has a line of trees along the water's edge.

items.title: Procession at the Foot of Mount Fuji
A Crow Chief at His Toilette
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a tipi in a grassy field, with Native American figures nearby engaging in daily activities. The scene includes horses grazing in the background and a serene sky with wispy clouds. The color palette consists of earthy tones and gentle blues.

items.title: Imaginary Regatta of America's Cup Winners
A Beauty Carrying Two Buckets of Flowers
River Landscape
items.description: We look through shadowed trees at a river winding into the distance in this horizontal landscape painting. Close to us, a cluster of three thin trees and a larger central tree are deep in shadow, which contrasts with the light-filled scene beyond. The topaz-blue river curves from the lower right corner, across the canvas, and into the distance at the center. A few spindly trees grow along the riverbank in front of a hut with a thatched roof to our right. The bank to our left is lined with reeds and tall grasses.

items.title: The Voyage of Life: Old Age
items.description: A balding, older man sits in a golden boat guided by a winged angel away from craggy rocks to calm waters, toward a shaft of light piercing a billowing bank of clouds in this horizontal landscape painting. The man and angel both have light skin. The man wears a crimson-red tunic and has a fringe of white curls and a long, white beard. He holds his hands up, palms facing out, as he looks toward the light in the upper left corner of the canvas. His golden boat is made up of wings and human bodies facing inward, the rudder and figurehead at the bow broken off.

items.title: A Distant View of Snow on the Sumida River in Edo
A Small Village - Payaguas Indians
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image displays a landscape framed in an oval shape, depicting a river scene. People and canoes are near the river, engaging in activities like fishing and paddling. Grassy banks lead to a settlement area where groups of people are gathered near simple structures. Tall trees form a canopy above the settlement. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating texture in the foliage and terrain. The color palette is earthy, with greens, yellows, browns, and blues dominating the scene. Taller trees reach into the sky in the background, completing the view.

items.title: Tea House Beside the Kamo River in Kyoto
Halting to Make a Sketch
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a scene viewed from an elevated point through an oval window. The horizon is in the upper part, with a dense wall of greenery made up of lush trees and palms. The foliage is vibrant with various shades of green, while the sky above displays soft blues and gentle grays. In the foreground, multiple figures are engaging in an activity on open land, with some animals present. The painting features fine brushstrokes, detailing plants and figures for a realistic effect within a controlled space.

items.title: Packet Ship Passing Castle Williams, New York Harbor
Boating Party on the Sumida River
A Connibo Wigwam
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a scene of daily life from an observational point of view. The horizon is positioned just above the middle of the composition, with dense green foliage stretching across the image. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a smooth texture in the sky, trees, and leaves. The color palette is earthy and muted, with greens, browns, soft blues, and grays dominating. In the foreground, a group of individuals is engaged in an activity, with some near a modest structure with a sloped roof on the left side.

items.title: Women in a Pleasure Boat on the Sumida River
items.medium: triptych of woodblock prints; ink and color on paper

items.title: Three Young Chinook Men
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The painting depicts three men seated on the ground. The man on the left is seated on a log with one leg over the other, holding a bow and a shield. He has long dark hair adorned with red and white feathers. The central figure is seated on the ground, holding a feathered fan and arrows, with a similar headdress made of red and white feathers. On the right, the third man sits on a rock, leaning slightly forward, holding a stick with both hands. His headband incorporates red and white feathers, and he wears beads around his neck.

items.title: Passengers in a Ferry Boat on the Sumida River
An Apachee Village
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image features a landscape with numerous conical tents arranged in a village. In the background, there is a line of trees marking the horizon, with low hills and a body of water further away. The sky shows a gradient from golden yellows to soft blues. Figures and tents are scattered across the landscape, indicating human activity. The color palette consists mainly of warm earthy tones, with the sky casting a soft light over the scene.

items.title: Venice: The Dogana and San Giorgio Maggiore
items.description: We look across a glittering waterway lined with long, low boats and sailboats at an ivory-white church in the distance to our right in this horizontal landscape painting. The horizon line comes about a third of the way up the composition, and wispy white clouds sweep across the brilliant azure-blue sky above. A row of buildings comes into view lining the canal to our right, with a terracotta-orange building followed by a cream-white building beyond, both angled toward the church. The church has a high dome rising over the temple-like front, which has columns supporting a triangular pediment.

items.title: Musashi, Omi, Yamashiro, and Settsu Provinces from the series Fashionable Six Jewel Rivers (Furyu Mu Tamagawa)
items.medium: polychrome woodblock print; ink and color on paper

items.title: Children Playing in a Park
items.description: This is a painting of a group of children holding hands and playing in a grassy area. The children form a line, with one crossing under the connected arms of two others. The children wear expressions of joy, with wide eyes and open, upturned mouths. Three of the children wear dresses in pastel pink, green, and blue, while the other three wear jackets and trousers. The background is a lush green landscape, and dappled light is cast on the scene from above.

items.title: A Thousand Autumns, Ten Thousand Years on Tokiwa Bridge
La Salle Received in the Village of the Cenis Indians.  May 6, 1686
items.description: The image is shown from an eye-level perspective, displaying a group of people and various structures. The horizon divides the sky from the land, revealing rolling hills and a cloudy sky tinged with a warm pinkish hue. People in traditional and 19th-century Western attire are present, with some on horseback and others engaged in activities. Buildings with conical shapes emit smoke to the left. Fine brushstrokes create detailed foliage and hills. The color scheme consists mainly of earth tones with red and white accents.

items.title: Samuel McKenney
items.description: The image displays a man's upper body. He is seated at a slight angle to the left, with one arm resting on a surface covered by a green cloth. The man has a composed expression, with defined facial features, including dark arched eyebrows, a high forehead, and short, dark hair with a subtle wave. He is dressed in formal attire, consisting of a black coat, a white shirt, and a cravat. A quill is placed nearby. The background is a plain, muted brown color.

items.title: A View of the Great Bridge at Senju in Musashi Province
Village at the Water's Edge
items.description: This painting depicts several rectangles in different colors layered over one another, giving the impression of an abstract landscape. The top of the painting is made with short brushstrokes in white, pink, and light blue, suggesting a cloudy sky. Closer to us, there are abstract, block-like shapes in shades of light brown, pale yellow, lilac, dark green, and eggplant-purple. Between some of these blocks, the orange-brown material under the paint shows through, dividing the different sections.

items.title: Flowers in a Rococo Vase
items.description: Rose and coral pink, vivid white, delphinium blue, and buttercup yellow flowers with deep green leaves are arranged in a blue and white vase in front of a pale sea-green background in this vertical still life painting. The vase has a white cup on a flaring foot. The vase is encircled with a twisting, decorative blue vine and scrolls. It sits on a band of peanut brown, suggesting a wooden tabletop. The still life is painted with blended strokes, giving the composition a soft, almost mottled appearance. The artist signed the painting in the lower left corner, “Cezanne.”

items.title: Kataoka Nizaemon VII and Ichikawa Yaozo III in a Confrontation Beside a Waterfall
On the Terrace
items.description: This is a painting of an outdoor gathering set in a pastoral landscape. A group of people dressed in soft, flowing garments are congregating under the trees, many of them sitting on the ground. Many of the people wear dresses and shawls in bright colors. The background displays a pastel-blue sky, tall leafy trees, and a serene green landscape that extends towards a distant horizon. On the far left appears to be the edge of a staircase or building, with one woman leaning against it with her back to us.

items.title: Harriet Husson Carville (Mrs. James G. Carville)
items.description: This painting is a portrait of a person with dark hair styled neatly in an updo with soft waves over their forehead. They have a serious expression, with pale skin, high cheekbones, deep-set eyes, dark eyebrows, and pink lips in a neutral expression. The person is wearing a pale blue garment with a vee-neck and slightly puffed sleeves, and they are turned slightly to the left. On the right, there are deep shadows on the side of their face and their neck. The background is a mixture of brown and gray shades with visible brushstrokes.

items.title: The Courtesans Hanamurasaki and Koshikibu of the Tamaya Promenading in the Rain
Salmon Spearing - Ottowas
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a nighttime landscape with a river extending towards the horizon. There are trees and foliage in the foreground, and the scene is illuminated by scattered fires casting a reddish glow. The color palette includes deep shades of blue and black. The sky and water are depicted with smooth, flowing brushwork.

items.title: Children Playing on the Beach
items.description: Two pale-skinned little girls sit back-to-back on a sandy beach, almost filling the width of this vertical painting. The girls wear matching pale, ice-blue pinafores over short sleeve, ocean-blue dresses. Both sit with their legs stretched in front of them and angled to our right. The girl closest to us, to our left, looks down at the denim-blue pail and wooden shovel she holds between her ankles. She holds the long-handled shovel in her near hand with the end inside the pail. She has a chubby, flushed, round face with blond hair and rosy arms and legs.

items.title: Landscape
items.medium: One of a pair of six-panel folding screens; ink and color on paper

items.title: Tawahquena Village
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is positioned in the upper third of the image where trees meet the sky, with teepees nestled at the base. Delicate brushstrokes are used, particularly in the depiction of the sky, which blends blue and peach tones. The scene is painted in warm colors, with greens for the grass and trees, browns for the horses, and reds in the grass. There are figures near horses and open grasslands leading to trees and teepees in the distance.

items.title: John Adams
items.description: Shown from the chest up, a balding, light-skinned man wears a port-red vest and coat in this vertical portrait painting. The man’s shoulders are angled to our right, but he turns his head to look at us from the corners of gray eyes under heavy, brown brows. His under-eyes are shaded blue and lined with wrinkles. He has a bumped nose, bow-shaped lips, a round chin, fleshy, flushed cheeks, and sagging jowls. His white hair sweeps up and to either side of a bald patch, painted with a white sheen, on the top of his head.

items.title: Landscape
items.medium: One of a pair of six-panel folding screens; ink and color on paper

items.title: Horsemen and Herdsmen with Cattle
items.description: Golden sunlight pours across a landscape with three people on horseback and two more people near a flock of sheep, a cow, and a mule in this horizontal painting. The people all have pale, peachy skin. The horizon is about a third of the way up the composition and is lined with towers on distant, hazy, pale yellow hills. Two of the horses are to the right of center, both facing us. The horse on the left is white, and the rider wears an azure-blue tunic and red brimless cap. The other horse is brown with a white blaze, and its rider wears a red tunic and black cap.

items.title: Girl in a Boat with Geese
items.description: At least one rowboat occupied by two people floats on a lake, which is surrounded by lush green vegetation in this vertical landscape painting. The scene is loosely painted with short and long parallel brushstrokes, so some details are difficult to make out. The white of the four geese lining the bank near us break up a color palette almost entirely dominated by spring, mint, and sage green and royal and baby blue. Three of the geese stand in a line and the fourth bends down to peck at the grass. A bed of deep pink flowers is indicated with touches of vibrant color to our right of the geese.

items.title: A Crow Village of Skin Tents on the Salmon River
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows a camp scene from an elevated viewpoint. There are several tipis scattered across the landscape with figures engaged in various activities. In the background, there are low hills and a softly glowing sky suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The land stretches into the distance with green vegetation and a partly obscured river or body of water on the right. The color palette consists of earthy browns and greens, contrasted by golden hues in the sky.

items.title: Rebecca Bryan White (Mrs. John White)
items.description: The painting shows a woman's figure from the waist up, seated, and her body is turned slightly to our left. Her head is turned to face the viewer. Her facial features are delicate, with a fair complexion, soft pink cheeks, and light blue eyes. She has long brown hair styled in voluminous waves, pulled back halfway and adorned with pearls. She is wearing a pale yellow gown with a low neckline accented by lace edges and a fabric decoration at the center of the bust. Her sleeves feature blue ribbon details and red jewel embellishments at the shoulders. The background is a muted brown.

items.title: Chinese Pavilions in a Landscape
items.medium: Six-panel folding screen, ink and light color on paper

items.title: A Blackfoot Chief, His Wife, and a Medicine Man
items.medium: oil on card mounted on paperboard
items.description: The image shows four individuals in traditional clothing and accessories. Two adults are seated in the center, one adult is standing to the left holding a spear and shield, and one child is standing to the right holding a bow and quiver. The setting includes an open landscape and clouds in the background. The image is framed within an oval on a beige border.

items.title: Georges Rivière
items.description: This painting shows a portrait of a man, seen from the shoulders upwards. The man is in profile, facing the left. He has short, dark brown hair that appears to be styled with a slight wave, dark eyebrows, pale skin, and red lips. His cheeks and visible ear are slightly pink. The man is dressed in a formal outfit with a black jacket, a white collared shirt, and a black bow tie. The background consists of a textured, abstract blend of pale green tones. The brushstrokes in the painting are visible, giving the portrait a blurred effect.

items.title: Autumn in the Mountains
items.medium: six-fold screen; ink and color with applied silver and gold leaf on paper

items.title: Forest Scene
items.description: A broken white and gray birch tree trunk has fallen across a rocky, shallow waterfall at the edge of a dense, deeply shadowed forest in this horizontal landscape painting. The narrow stream winds toward us from the forest to splash into a rocky pool that nearly spans the width of the painting along the bottom edge. The tree trunk angles from our right down into the pool, having lost most of its branches. Broken off near the base, the gnarled roots of the tree dig into a rocky outcropping along the right edge of the composition. Farther back and tiny in scale, two people walk along the stream.

items.title: Francis Hopkinson
items.description: This painting is a portrait showing the upper torso and head of a man turned slightly to the right. The man is looking at us with a neutral expression. His facial features include pale skin, a high forehead, dark eyebrows, and dark hair styled with waves and curls around his temples. He is wearing a black coat over a white shirt. The shirt is adorned with a white cravat wrapped around his neck, visible above the coat's collar. The background is a brown shade, and the painting is marked with the initials "TS" and "1834" at the bottom left corner.

items.title: Painting from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: album; ink and color on silk

items.title: Berks County Almshouse, 1895
items.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a pastoral community with a central large building complex surrounded by lush greenery and small structures. The horizon is high, displaying rolling hills and a light-filled sky. The brushstrokes are detailed, highlighting symmetrical trees, fields, and buildings. The color palette includes greens, reds, browns, and soft blues, accented by white picket fences and an American flag. Horse-drawn carriages and small figures are visible, and smoke rises from a chimney in the distance.

items.title: Painting from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: album; ink and color on silk

items.title: The Cornell Farm
items.description: Cows, horses, sheep, and pigs stand closely together in a band across the bottom edge of this horizontal painting. Rolling hills open onto grassy lawns, farms, and fields beyond. The two dozen cows spanning the leftmost two-thirds of the painting are cream white, tawny, russet, or dark brown, or speckled with brown or black and white. White sheep, six adult and one baby, cluster beyond the cows, to our left. Five black pigs are behind the cows across the middle of the picture, one of them suckling several piglets.

items.title: Preface from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: leaf from folding-album; ink on paper

items.title: A Wooded Landscape
items.description: A rutted, dirt road curves from the bottom center of the canvas toward and behind a grove of tall trees to our left, beneath a pale blue sky with fluffy white clouds that fills the top two-thirds of this horizontal landscape painting. The broad, green canopies of the trees to our left create deep shade over twisting trunks, shrubs, and grasses. A narrow stream meandering alongside the road to our left reflects the moss, pine, and sage greens of the leaves. The land rises in a sloping bank to our right, and leads back to open fields with hedgerows that stretch to the horizon.

items.title: Painting from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: album; ink and color on silk

items.title: Woods in Winter
items.description: This painting shows a winter landscape with snow-covered ground and tall, dark trees with straight trunks. The color palette is almost entirely white, gray, and black, with some dark brown leaves on the trees. Small gray shrubs and grass are visible peeking through the white snow, and the dense trees cast gray shadows. The sky beyond the trees is white.

items.title: Painting from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: album; ink and color on silk

items.title: Waterfall with Log Cabins
items.description: This painting shows a landscape with rugged gray rocks, rolling green hills, and tall trees with leaves in shades of dark green and rusty orange. On the left, red and gray wooden structures sit on the rocky ground, surrounded by scattered rocks and tree limbs. Small white goats walk on the rocks around the buildings. A gray river flows from near the buildings down to a waterfall at the center of the painting. The sky above is light blue and covered with white and gray clouds.

items.title: Painting from Flowers and Grasses
items.medium: album; ink and color on silk

items.title: Penn's Treaty with the Indians
items.description: Eight pale-skinned men and thirteen brown-skinned, indigenous Lenape men, women, and a baby gather on a grassy field close to us in this horizontal painting. The white men are cleanshaven and have puffy gray, shoulder-length hair. Most wear black tricorn hats, and they all wear coats, vests, and pants in shades of tan, gray, red, brown, and white. An unfurled scroll in the middle of this group reaches from shoulder to calf, and most of the word “Pennsylvania” is legible there. Two bareheaded men kneel in front of the Lenape, holding a bolt of red cloth.

items.title: Winter Scene with Plum Trees and Pheasants (Birds Left)
items.medium: pair of six-fold screens, mineral pigments and gold leaf on paper

items.title: Indians Cooking Maize
items.description: The image shows three figures gathered around a fire in a natural setting. One is cooking outside a conical shelter, possibly a tepee. A woman and child stand nearby. In the background, there are hills, a sky with pink and blue hues, and distant blue-green mountains. The painting has detailed brushstrokes creating texture in the trees and river. The color palette includes earthy tones, greens, and blues, with a warm glow from the fire. Small details like a canoe on the riverbank add to the calm exploration of the scene.

items.title: Winter Scene with Plum Trees and Pheasants (Birds Right)
items.medium: pair of six-fold screens, mineral pigments and gold leaf on paper,

items.title: Lake Albano
items.description: The painting shows a green landscape from an elevated point of view. At the bottom of the image, a small group of people is seen on a grassy green hill. In the closest group, there is a tall person with a dog and two children, while farther down the hill are two other small people. Behind the hill is a large, reflective body of water surrounded by trees and other hills on either side. Behind the water, the scene opens into flatlands and rolling hills under a vast blue sky with soft white clouds. There appears to be a small village far in the distance.

items.title: Spring Dance Scene
items.medium: hanging scroll; ink and color on silk

items.title: Leaving the Manor House
items.description: The image depicts a painting of an estate overlooking a body of water. An ornate house with white columns and pink and peach checkered steps is in the foreground. A man and a woman in Victorian attire stand on the pathway. A horse-drawn carriage and a greyhound are nearby. A path leads to the riverside with a person on horseback riding alongside. Sailboats drift on the water, and buildings are visible in the distance. Soft, billowy clouds fill the sky, and the color palette consists of pastel tones including warm yellows, oranges, greens, and blues.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Landscape after Wu Zhen
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: The Neigh of an Iron Horse
items.description: This painting shows a side view of a horse and a steam train in an open landscape. The reddish-brown horse is in the center of the painting, its legs bent and its head turned over its shoulder, looking to the left. Its long brown mane and tail appear to be blown to the left by the wind, and its one visible eye is wide, its mouth partially open. The gray-and-brown train is depicted in the background on the left, following a thin curving track, plumes of white and gray smoke flowing up from it. The color palette includes brown, green, blue, and white shades.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Landscape after Ni Zan
The Fortress of Königstein: Courtyard with the Magdalenenburg
items.description: The painting depicts a stately building complex from an elevated point. The buildings are large, with white, ivy-covered walls and dark, peaked roofs. One building on the left is directly ahead of us, while a closer building on the right sits on a small hill. The buildings are connected by wide gray paths and small stairs. Small people walk the paths or stand on the surrounding grass wearing dresses or suits in bright colors, some with white wigs or pointed hats. The light is warm, and the people cast soft shadows on the grass. Tall trees near the buildings provide areas of shade.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Snowy Landscape
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Diana and Endymion
items.description: Close to us, a woman and a winged, child-like putto float on clouds above a clean-shaven young man in a forest setting in this horizontal painting. All three people have smooth, pale skin, rosy cheeks, and ash-blond hair. The man reclines with his torso propped so his feet extend along the rocky ground to our left. He rests his head in his right hand, farther from us, with that elbow resting on a rock. We look up onto the underside of his chin and delicate features. A scarlet-red robe falls from his shoulders and across his hips.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Landscape with Artist on a Bridge
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: A View on a High Road
items.description: Several people sit, stand, or stroll along a dirt road that winds from the lower left corner of this horizontal landscape painting into the distance, past trees and cottages under a vivid blue sky. The horizon line comes about a third of the way up the canvas, and the cloud studded, azure-blue sky fills the space above. Sunlight filtered through puffy white and steel-gray clouds illuminates the scene from the upper right, creating patches of light and shadow throughout.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Shibiao Waiting for the Moon
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Rebecca at the Well
items.description: Three men, one woman, and three camels gather around the stone ledge of a well in this horizontal landscape painting. Along the left edge of the composition and on the far side of the well, a man with brown skin and short, black hair faces away from us as he reaches for the reins of two camels, one of which looks at or toward us. This man wears an emerald-green shirt under a canary-yellow tunic, which is tied in place with a strap over one shoulder.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Boating in Spring Water
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Moonlight on the Yare
items.description: Two windmills are backlit by silvery moonlight along the horizon of this loosely painted, horizontal landscape. The horizon comes about a third of the way up the composition. The left half of the painting is nearly filled with a towering tree with muted olive-green leaves and a tan trunk. Some dark branches dip toward the river that runs from the bottom center of the painting into the distance, in front of the windmills. Light shimmers on the gently rippling surface, which is lined to our right with grassy vegetation.

items.title: Landscape Album in Various Styles: Scenery of Mt. Changbai after Huang Gongwang
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Landscape with Buildings
items.description: This painting shows a green landscape seen from afar. In the distance, there are large white buildings partially obscured by tall leafy trees. Small people engage in leisure activities, such as walking along the grass, playing games, or sitting together. On the far left are two cows or horses in an open field. The color palette is mainly comprised of dark green, brown, and olive tones. The sky behind the trees is dark blue at the top of the painting, and transitions into a lighter yellow or peach color near the horizon.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: Album of ten leaves; ink and color on paper

items.title: Fête Champêtre
items.description: This painting shows a group of people gathered outdoors, surrounded by dark, olive-green trees. Elegantly dressed people with light skin interact, two standing in the center in between groups sitting on the left and right. In the center are a woman in a flowing yellow gown and a man with a green cape and a red cap with a tall white feather. The people sitting on either side, including men, women, and children, look towards the two in the center or turn towards each other, speaking.

items.title: Landscape
items.medium: folding fan, ink and color on gold paper

items.title: The Herdsman
items.description: A man with tanned skin is surrounded by animals as he reclines against a grassy slope in this horizontal landscape painting. The area close to us is darkened or in shadow, so some details are difficult to make out, but the land brightens under a golden sky as it recedes into the deep, hazy distance. In the lower left corner of the canvas, the man faces our right in profile, looking toward the grazing animals. He wears a wide-brimmed hat and a caramel-brown jacket over a knee-length garment. He leans back on his near arm with one leg bent and the other extended.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: Solitude
items.description: The partial ruins of a stone lion on a tall pedestal stands at the edge of a body of water in a verdant green landscape in this horizontal painting. The lion statue is broken so only the back half of the body and one front paw remain. The animal’s tail winds through the back legs, and the front paw rests on a ball. The pedestal is chipped and cracked, and some of the surface on the front is worn away to show brick underneath. A pale-skinned man lies on the ground with one elbow propped on the base of the pedestal. His chest is bare.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: The Gift of the Fishermen
items.description: This painting depicts a gathering of people in a landscape setting. In the center, a woman in a pale gray dress is sitting, looking at a man in a pale pink suit who is kneeling next to her on the right. More men and women wearing elaborate dresses and suits are gathered on the ground around them, many of them disappearing into shadow on the left. On the right, there are two young girls, one appearing to have objects gathered in her white apron. Behind them, three men with their legs partially submerged in water appear to be pulling something upward by a rope.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: Landscape
items.description: This painting depicts a landscape with a variety of trees set against a blue-grey sky. Different shades of green are used for the leaves of the trees, which are outlined in dark, reddish-brown. A tree in the center has blue-grey branches and dense, bright green foliage. A small white house is seen to the left. The ground is white with patches of reddish-brown and green-and-blue stripes by the bottom right corner. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape
items.medium: Album of twelve leaves, ink and color on paper

items.title: The Forum at Pompeii
items.description: This painting shows ancient ruins made of reddish-brown stone. In front of these dilapidated walls are lines of tan and gray columns and free-standing arches. The brown ground is littered with cream-colored stones. In the background, there are rolling gray hills and distant mountains under a blue sky with fluffy white clouds.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Landscape with Two Boatmen)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Berks County Almshouse, 1878
items.description: This painting displays several views of landscapes and buildings, all surrounding a central, oval depiction of one landscape with several buildings. At the bottom is a label that reads "Views of the Buildings & Surroundings of the Berks County Alms House. 1878". The scenes include lush hills, clear skies, and a variety of buildings. In the center is the main complex of the Alms House with red buildings, gardens, fields, roads, carriages, and livestock. Surrounding this central oval is a decorative border with a crest or shield at the top.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Waterfall Landscape)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: American Landscape
items.description: The painting features a valley with purple and brown mountains in the distance, surrounding a reflective body of water with a small rowboat floating on it. Closer to us, there are gray rocks, brown tree trunks and branches, and lush green vegetation at the edge of the water. The sky above is painted in warm shades of yellow, peach, and orange, which transition to pale greenish-blue at the top. The water below reflects these colors, as well as those of the distant mountain and surrounding trees.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Landscape with Hill)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: River Landscape with Cows
items.description: Eight cows bathed in warm sunlight stand and lie on a riverbank carpeted in mossy green in this horizontal painting. The cows are amber, ginger, or tawny brown, bone white, or black, and all have short, curving horns. Seven are clustered closely together, at the bottom center of the painting. There, one tawny red cow with a white face looks at or toward us as it lies at the middle of the grouping, legs tucked under her big body. The eighth cow is black with a white face, and lies just to our left of the group.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Cliff Landscape with Bridge)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Landscape with Herdsmen
items.description: Warm sunlight bathes a scene with a herd of five golden tan, ivory, or chocolate-brown cows lying or standing on a low hill near four people on foot and on horseback in this horizontal landscape painting. The people all have pale, peachy skin. The horizon line is about a quarter of the way up the composition and is lined in the deep distance with spires rising over trees. Close to us and at the center of the composition, two cows look off to our left in profile; one is caramel brown and lies on the ground in front of a standing, gray cow.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Landscape with Two Buildings)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Spring Woods
items.description: This painting depicts a sunlit forest with densely packed trees. Sunlight filters through the leaves, casting a warm glow and illuminating shades of green with hints of yellow and gold. The forest floor is covered in dark green vegetation and gray rocks, with small visible people in the distance. One of the people is wearing a red shirt or jacket. In the background, the trees become less defined and merge into a misty blur of light and dark greens. The paint has been applied with thick, visible brushstrokes.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: The Prophet Elijah and the Widow of Zarephath
items.description: In a landscape with ruins overgrown with plants, a bearded, old man greets a kneeling young woman and boy near the lower right corner in this horizontal painting. At least seven people move through the landscape beyond, and everyone has light skin and is barefoot. In the trio to the lower right, the man stands facing our right in profile. He has a steel-gray beard and hair, a prominent nose, and his mouth is closed. He wears a thistle-purple tunic under a scarlet-red cloak. He looks down at the woman, and he holds out his right hand, closer to us, toward her.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: Skating on the Frozen Amstel River
items.description: We look slightly down onto a scene showing light-skinned men, women, and children ice skating on a frozen river in this horizontal landscape painting. We get the impression of hundreds of people gathered on the ice creating a crowd that extends into the hazy distance. The couple dozen closest to us are the most defined. A few clusters of people and individuals in particular draw our attention. For example, a group of three men wearing dark cloaks and hats stand in conversation on our right. Two boys nearby hold sticks and play a game similar to hockey.

items.title: Landscapes after Various Styles of Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: View of a Villa, Pizzofalcone, Naples
items.description: This painting shows a white and tan building on the edge of a rocky cliff, seen from slightly below. There are arched openings within the cliffside, with some other small buildings tucked into them. The ground is brown and covered with leafy greenery on the top of the cliff and in a cave on the left, with a patch of green grass in the bottom right corner. In the center, distant people and a horse-drawn cart walk on a path below the cliff, towards one of the openings. The sky above is blue with scattered white clouds.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: The Lavie Children
items.description: Three young boys, four girls, and a dark brown dog gather in a loose semi-circle in a grassy clearing near a grove of trees in this horizontal landscape painting. The children all have pale skin with flushed cheeks, brown hair, and dark eyes. The girls wear corseted dresses with long skirts and cap-like bonnets, and the boys wear jackets with tails, knee-length pants, stockings, and black shoes with buckles. The three boys look at us while the four girls look around the scene. A long plank of wood has been laid across a thick, sawed tree trunk to make a seesaw.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: The Finding of Moses
items.description: Nine women and girls create a procession leading to a blond, smiling infant lying in a basket being held by a man next to a riverbank that runs across this horizontal landscape painting. The tallest woman, near the center of the retinue, wears a gold, crown-like diadem, and a toga-like gown of golden yellow over a pale, slate-blue, short-sleeved dress. She stands facing our left in profile, and looks toward the baby with dark eyes under dark, arched eyebrows. Her nose is long and straight, her pink lips are closed in a faint smile, and she has a rounded chin and jawline.

items.title: Landscapes in Various Styles after Old Masters
items.medium: album leaf: ink and color on paper

items.title: Members of the Maynard Family in the Park at Waltons
items.description: The painting depicts two women and two children. In the center, a woman sits on a bench, her body facing us and her head turned to the right. She plays a lute-like instrument. Her brown hair is styled with a ribbon, and her attire consists of a blue gown with ruffles. A hat with a blue ribbon hangs next to her on the bench. On the right, a child in a white dress stands next to a woman in a red dress adorned with lace, who is seated on a low bench. Her hair is styled beneath a lace cap, and a hat with a red ribbon is on the bench to the right.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Old Man on Donkey)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Flax Scutching Bee
items.description: This painting depicts a rural scene with people gathered in front of log cabins. Hills, sparse trees, and a haystack are visible in the background under a partly cloudy sky. In the distance on the left, two people stand on a pile of logs, a small fire breaking out on the far left and putting gray smoke in the air. Closer to us on the left, a man stands by a machine made of several horizontal rods, appearing to feed long strands of fiber or grain into it.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Landscape with Hill, House, Boat and Bridge)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: La Camargo Dancing
items.description: Twenty-one men in long waistcoats and women in elegantly trimmed gowns gather and dance within a verdant landscape in this horizontal painting. The men wear jackets and breeches in ginger brown, pale pink, or spruce blue. The women’s gowns have full sleeves, tight-fitting bodices, and full skirts in shades of bronze, teal blue, butterscotch gold, or rich pink edged with ribbons and lace. Some of them wear floral wreaths or ribbons in their upswept hair. Groups gather around a woman and man who dance together to our left in the scene.

items.title: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: The Fortress of Königstein
items.description: In the distance, a fortress sits on a rocky plateau below a sky filled with lightly rolling white and gray clouds in this horizontal landscape painting. The horizon line is low, about a quarter of the way up the composition, so the plateau and fortress loom high above the surrounding land. The fortress is made up two distinct sections, with a nearly windowless stronghold or massive city wall to the right and what looks like a row of six interconnected white rowhouses to the left. More rooflines peek over the stronghold.

items.title: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: A Man Reclining and Enjoying the View
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Mountain Landscape at Sunset
items.description: The dark, forest-green canopies of trees to our right are silhouetted against a sky that warms from pale blue along the top edge of the composition to butter yellow along the horizon, which comes about a quarter of the way up this horizontal landscape painting. The scene is loosely painted so many details are vague and difficult to make out.

items.title: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Man Resting under Bamboo
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Maryland Heights: Siege of Harpers Ferry
items.description: This horizontal landscape painting shows a panoramic view of a river valley and an encampment from an elevated vantage point. The horizon runs about halfway up the composition beneath a wide expanse of pale blue sky dotted with a few puffy white clouds. A rocky bluff runs along the bottom edge of the canvas, closest to us. Three people in uniforms of dark blue jackets and lighter blue pants sit or stand among the sparce trees and shrubs there. One faces away from us, one sits on a boulder and smokes a pipe, and one gestures across the river.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man and Woman)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Old Factory
items.description: This painting shows a large brown building from the side. The building is on the left, with a tall chimney and several layers of windows. On the right, the horizon is dotted with dark trees. Closer to us is a green field with small bushes on it. The sky at the top of the painting is pale blue with gray clouds. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and textured, creating a sense of movement in the sky and landscape.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Two Men with Umbrella)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Erminia and the Shepherds
items.artist: Gian Antonio Guardi and Francesco Guardi
items.description: This painting shows a group of people engaged in various activities within a wide green landscape. In the background are distant white-and-blue mountains and a blue sky with soft gray clouds. Near the center is a distant white building with a pointed roof. Closer to us, on the left, a bearded man sits near a wooden structure on the far left. Near the bottom left corner, a black goat and a white sheep sit beside the man. One child stands in the wooden structure, while three other children are in the center of the painting, sitting together on the ground.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Three Men)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: The Worship of the Golden Calf
items.description: Dozens of men, women, and a few children gather in groups amid a grassy landscape with a mountain in the distance in this horizontal painting. All of the people have pale or ruddy skin and wear flowing cloaks over long tunics or gowns. Warm light from the upper left illuminates the two groups closest to us, which cluster along the left and right edges of the canvas. Each group is set against a dark background suggesting cave walls or rocky outcroppings. On our left, an elderly man sits with his back to us as he looks across this shoulder to our right.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man with Staff)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Scenes from a Legend
items.artist: Giovanni Larciani (Master of the Kress Landscapes)
items.description: Two pairs of people and a group line a rocky path that stretches away from us in this hilly, horizontal landscape painting. We look slightly down on the path as it travels steeply from the bottom center of the canvas to about the center of the composition. Dark trees and bushes are tucked on top of and between knolls and mounds rising to each side of the path. A pink-stone building with a crenelated walled area and a tower is to the left of center, and a second building is tucked in a shallow valley to the right.

items.title: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man Riding Carp)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Ralph Wheelock's Farm
items.description: We look across a grassy field toward farm buildings spaced along a low rise, outlined against a blue sky in this long, horizontal landscape painting. Just over a dozen mounds, like green haystacks, create a row along the bottom edge of the composition. Several men wearing white shirts, black pants, and tall, black hats work with rakes nearby. One man, wearing a yellow hat, walks holding the hand of a child, who wears a red shirt. A dog trots alongside another man who carries a basket and a bottle. To our right, another man works next to a wagon loaded with the green harvest.

items.title: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems:  Three Big Trees, a Stream with an Old Man Sitting on the Bank
items.medium: album leaf, ink and light color on paper

items.title: Landscape with Open Gate
items.description: We look across a rutted, dirt road at a rickety wooden gate that leans precipitously to our right, at the same angle as the bare tree behind it in this horizontal landscape painting. The road curves from the lower right corner to the center of the composition, and continues back over a low rise. The gate leans back at an angle next to the road, near the lower right center of the painting. An area in shadow to our right could be the fence continuing along in front of a building with a sloping, moss-green roof that echoes the angle of the gate and tree.

items.title: Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
The Cat
items.description: This is a painting of a large cat's head amidst birds in a forest setting. The cat's head emerges from tall grass, and the rest of its body is not visible. Its fur is a mix of brown and black with a cream area around its nose and cheeks, and it has long white whiskers. Its ears are pricked up, and its yellow eyes are looking upwards. In the cat's mouth is a bird with blue and green feathers, a black head, and a long black beak.

items.title: Desk Album: Flower and Bird Paintings (mallow flowers)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: The Connecticut Valley
items.description: This painting features a landscape with trees and foliage in dark greens, browns, and orange-red tones. In front of us, a steep mountain rises, covered with detailed trees in shades of green, orange, and yellow. Behind it, a river winds from left to right, the bank lined with more green trees and small white buildings, with several small white boats floating on the surface of the gray water. Behind the river are more mountains, some fading into the distance, painted in muted blues and greens. The blue sky has puffy clouds in shades of white, pale yellow, light gray, and darker gray.

items.title: Desk Album: Flower and Bird Paintings (Climbing Blue Flowers)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: The Grave of William Penn
items.description: This painting shows a pastoral setting with a large white-and-gray house on a hill to the left. Distant people stand in front of the house, along with a horse-drawn wagon. In the bottom right corner, two people sit in the grass under a tree, one dressed in red holding a tall crook and the other wearing a black garment and a yellow hat and petting a large brown-and-white dog. There is a basket on the ground between them, and next to them is a large herd of cows and sheep, all resting on the grass. The landscape includes trees with green leaves and yellow hills in the distance.

items.title: Painting Five from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
The Travelers
items.description: Two light-skinned men on horseback ride toward us on a rutted, country road set in a sweeping view with a watermill along a river to our left, and a screen of trees to our right in this horizontal landscape painting. The horizon comes about a third of the way up the composition, and many of the trees and the watermill are shown against the white and dove-gray clouds rolling across the pale blue sky. The riders are small in scale when compared to the landscape. The man to our left rides a chestnut-brown horse and wears a red jacket and a black, wide-brimmed hat pushed back on his head.

items.title: Painting Ten from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
Skating Scene
items.description: The painting depicts a wintry scene from an elevated point of view, showing people skating and playing games on a frozen river. On the left, leafless trees line the frozen bank. On the right, there are brown buildings with snow on their roofs and smoke rising from their chimneys. A woman stands on one of the porches, holding a small child. On the snowy ground outside the buildings, a sled is being pulled by two horses. In the center of the painting is the wide frozen river. The people on it wear colorful clothes in shades of red, yellow, green, blue, and brown.

items.title: Painting Three from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
A Scene on the Ice
items.description: We look slightly down onto a panorama with dozens of pale-skinned men, women, and children skating and standing on a frozen river in this horizontal landscape painting. Most of the men wear black hats and suits, some with white collars and hip-length capes. The women all wear ankle- or floor-length skirts, and some are covered with black cloaks that drape over their heads to their feet. Many people wear black but some of the clothing is scarlet red, sage green, celestial blue, beige, or slate gray.

items.title: Painting Seven from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
The Barnyard
items.description: The painting depicts a rural farmstead. On the left, two horses stand near a gray wooden barn, with cows standing and sitting on the right in front of a fenced-in green field. The ground below the animals is brown, with patches of yellow, green, and cream. There is a white two-story house with blue shutters and a white picket fence in the distance. The sky is grayish-blue with light clouds. Trees around the house and barn show hints of green and brown.

items.title: Painting Nine from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
New England Farm in Winter
items.description: The painting depicts a winter scene. The horizon is in the top third of the image, with a line of dark evergreen trees below a sky of soft blues and hints of yellow. Closer to us, a flat expanse of land with several buildings on it is covered in snow. A woman and child on the right stand near a house with chickens nearby. The chickens fill the snow, and the woman is turned to the left, one arm outstretched towards them and the other holding a large bowl. The child is behind her legs, looking back at a small cat or dog that stands on the right.

items.title: Painting Two from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
View of Lake Nemi
items.description: A sheer cliff looming across a deep valley is backlit by a low sunset in this is horizontal landscape painting. The tree closest to us grows up above the canopies of trees that fill the valley and nearly touches the top edge of the composition. Brown buildings clustered near the edge of the cliff are outlined against the sunset sky. Light falls across the landscape from the left, casting the right face of the cliff into shadow.

items.title: Painting Eight from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
Siberian Dogs in the Snow
items.description: Two creamy-white, long-haired dogs facing our right in a snowy field fill this horizontal painting. The scene is painted with visible, textured strokes in shades of white and ice blue. The dogs have floppy ears and long muzzles. They both stand with heads lowered, focused on something out of view to the right. Their coats are painted with strokes of parchment and ivory white with shading in arctic and sky blue. Their bodies cast blue shadows on the snow beneath them, and dried, flax-yellow twigs angled to our left poke out from the ground around them.

items.title: Painting Eleven from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
Imaginary River Landscape
items.description: We look down and across a river valley into a mountainous landscape in this horizontal painting. Most of the mountains, trees, and buildings in the middle and deep distance are painted in tones of ice and cobalt blue. The horizon comes about halfway up the painting. In the sky, an intense gold glow comes from the left and illuminates the clouds across the picture. A field of flat aquamarine-blue sky shows through the clouds at the top center. The land closest to us is dark brown and green, backlit by the low sunlight.

items.title: Painting Twelve from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
Glass and Checkerboard
items.description: Irregular, geometric shapes in burnt orange, pale peach, light blue, forest and mint green, brown, taupe, gray, and black are layered and spread across this horizontal, abstract painting. They are mostly flat planes of color. One shape to our right of center has four rows of rounded rectangles to create a checkboard pattern of sage green against terracotta brown. A wide parchment-brown band divides the checkboard from top to bottom. The artist signed the lower right, “Juan Gris.”

items.title: Desk Album: Flower and Bird Paintings (Bats, rocks, flowers circular calligraphy)
items.medium: album leaf, ink and color on paper

items.title: Peaceful Valley
items.description: The painting depicts a rural landscape at sunset or sunrise. The horizon is slightly above the center, showing distant pale-pink and purple mountains against the sky. Closest to us is an area with dark green bushes and vegetation, leading to a lighter green field surrounded by green-and-brown trees. The palette is warm and earthy, with greens and browns in the bottom transitioning to purples and pinks in the distance. The sky is a pale-yellow color that fades into light blue towards the top left corner, and faint yellow and gray clouds drift across it.

items.title: Painting Four from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
The Wind
items.description: Tall trunks and the canopies trees sweep to our left in a stiff wind in this horizontal landscape painting. The bottom half of the canvas is packed solid with leafy trees. Several spindly trunks shoot high above the canopy against a sky mottled with a sheet of pale gray clouds. The artist signed and dated the painting in the lower left corner, “F. VALLOTTON. 10.”

items.title: Painting Six from Illustrated Book of Flowers and Butterflies
Apollo and Marsyas
items.artist: Sienese 16th Century, possibly Bartolomeo di David
items.description: A young person with dark blond hair, wearing a knee-length, pale yellow toga, stands playing a violin-like instrument at the center of this long, horizontal landscape painting. A pair of people are to the left and another pair to the right. Most of the people have pale skin, and two of the men have slightly darker, tanned complexions. The person at the center, Apollo, nearly spans the height of the painting. He tips his head back and to our right, toward the instrument on his shoulder, and he looks at us with dark eyes, lips parted.
